 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid non-background row or column separates the two patterns.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        upper, lower = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        n = min(len(upper), len(lower))
        return [[2 if upper[r][c] != 0 and lower[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] and grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h))), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        left_w, right_w = sep_col, w - sep_col - 1
        n = min(left_w, right_w)
        return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][sep_col + 1 + c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('No solid separator found')
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
